heroSummary: Granite School District students start Monday, August 16, 2027, and the last student day is Thursday, May 25, 2028. The approved calendar includes 179 student days. Parent-teacher conference dates vary by school level, with no school September 17 and February 18 for conference compensation days.
calendarNotes: Granite School District students begin August 16 after five pre-year teacher contract days August 9–13. The approved calendar lists 179 student days across four terms of 47, 38, 46, and 48 days. Senior high, junior high, and elementary SEP conferences use different dates in September and February. September 17 and February 18 are conference compensation days when students do not attend. Fall Break is October 21–22, Winter Break is December 23–31, and Spring Break is April 3–7. Additional no-school and teacher contract days extend several breaks and term transitions during the year. The final student day and fourth-term ending are Thursday, May 25, 2028.

whatsNew.title: 2027–28 Compared With 2026–27
content: The first student day moves from August 12 to August 16, while the last day moves from May 26 to May 25.
The student-day total rises from 176 to 179.
Term distribution changes from 45/40/45/46 days to 47/38/46/48 days; the second term becomes shorter while the other three grow.
Fall Break moves to October 21–22, Winter Break begins December 23, and Spring Break moves to April 3–7.
Granite currently lists a separate A/B calendar for 2026–27 but not for 2027–28. Families should not reuse the earlier year's rotation.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Granite School District start in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: The first student day is Monday, August 16, 2027. Teachers have five pre-year contract days August 9–13.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Granite School District Fall Break in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Fall Break is October 21–22, 2027. Students also have no school Monday, October 25 for an end-of-term teacher contract day and return Tuesday, October 26.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Granite School District Winter Break in 2027–28?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break runs December 23–31, 2027. Students remain out January 3 for an end-of-term teacher contract day and return Tuesday, January 4.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Granite School District Spring Break in 2028?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break runs Monday, April 3, through Friday, April 7, 2028. Students return Monday, April 10.

Fall dates are September 15–16 for senior high, September 14–15 for junior high, and September 13–14 for elementary SEP conferences. Winter dates are February 14–15, February 16–17, and February 15–16 respectively.

calendarFaqs.q: Are Fridays early-out days for Granite elementary schools in 2027–28?
calendarFaqs.a: The approved PDF's P marker means an elementary planning day with early dismissal on instructional Fridays. Confirm the actual dismissal time with the school.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Granite School District's last day of school in 2028?
calendarFaqs.a: The last student day is Thursday, May 25, 2028, when Term 4 ends.

calendarFaqs.q: How many student days are in Granite's 2027–28 calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: The approved calendar lists 179 student days: 47 in Term 1, 38 in Term 2, 46 in Term 3, and 48 in Term 4.

sourceReviewSummary: Reviewed August 10, 2026, against Granite School District's live calendar page and a visually rendered copy of both pages of the complete approved 2027–28 calendar.
sourceReviewDetailsTitle: How we verified the approved Granite calendar
sourceReviewDetails: The source is a two-page Granite School District 2027-2028 calendar marked approved by the Board March 3, 2026.
Both pages were rendered and checked visually because shaded date bars, P planning markers, conference labels, term boundaries, and calendar codes do not survive plain-text extraction reliably.
The four official term counts sum to the printed total of 179 student days.
The School Calendar Summary lists 10 additional teacher contract days: five before students begin, three at the end of a term, and two for planning and professional development.
Conference dates were transcribed separately for senior high, junior high, and elementary SEP meetings instead of being collapsed into one misleading districtwide window.
The approved PDF defines P as a planning day with early dismissal for elementary schools; exact school bell times are not inferred.
Granite's official calendar page did not list a separate 2027-2028 A/B calendar when reviewed on August 10, 2026, so the 2026-2027 rotation was not carried forward.
The .ics file is a one-time import and does not update automatically if Granite revises the approved calendar.
sourceMaintainerText: MySchoolDates Calendar Data Team using official Granite School District sources.
